text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
It seems a fan letter has arrived for me.
I shall give it a read.

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
"Watching Furioso-san run
made me want to do my best too!"

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
"Furioso-san, you are our shining star!
Please don't lose to the Central Umamusume!
Always and forever, we'll be cheering for you from Funabashi!"
choice_data_list: I'm so glad to hear that!!

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text: ...That should be all, then.

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
"We have the next race coming up, too,
so shall we do some training?"

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
Ah, before that, I'll go buy some groceries.
Take your time getting here, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Furioso placed the letter on the desk
and hurried off toward the training grounds.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: Ah! Furioso-san's Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Um... Furioso-san, is something wrong?
When we passed each other, you had such a serious look on your face...

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Huh! A fan letter from someone back home?
Then what was that look on your face earlier...?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Indeed, she wasn't smiling. But as much as
she loves Funabashi, there's no way she wasn't happy.
That's why—
choice_data_list: Furioso's thrilled, I just know it.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: Oh, really?

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: ...Hehe.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
"It really feels like you two understand each other.
It's nice."

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
Ah, Trainer. Good work today.
I just finished running some errands.

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text: I was just thinking about heading to the Trainer's office.
choice_data_list: You went shopping? What did you buy?
You went shopping? What did you get?

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
This?
This is—

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
"This is a folder for preserving letters.
I wanted to protect them right away."

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
To my surprise, they had one with a camellia pattern.
It's our city tree, so I thought it'd be perfect.

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
Fufu. It is exceedingly cute.
I shall show it to you after training.
